RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, February 8, 2019/Magha 19, 1940 (Saka)
————
(Ministries :  Agriculture and Farmers Welfare; Chemicals and Fertilizers;
Coal; Communications; Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution;
Electronics and Information Technology; Food Processing Industries;
Law and Justice; Railways; Statistics and Programme Implementation)
Total number of questions — 15
23
Installation of solar power projects on
unused railway land
*61. DR. AMEE Y AJNIK: Will the
Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has any
proposal to utilise its unused land pool for
installation of solar power projects;
(b) if so, the detailed list of nodal
agencies and officers appointed for the
purpose;
(c) the details about any proposal from
any MNC in this regard and the progress
made so far; and
(d) the details about the time-frame for
the completion of the project?
Allocation of Microwave Access
spectrum
*62. SHRI  RAVI  PRAKASH
VERMA: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS be pleased to state:
(a) whether serious irregularities in
allocation of Microwave Access spectrum
in 2015 have been reported by CAG
recently;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government has initiated
inquiry into the alleged irregularities to fix
responsibility;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Non-disbursement of MSP to farmers
*63. SHRI RIPUN BORA: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE AND
FARMERS WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the farmers
in the country are still unable to repay loans
due to non-receiving of MSP in the country;
(b) if so, the details of Central support
of MSP to farmers for the period 2016-17,
2017-18 and April to December, 2018,
crop-wise;

24
(c) the disbursement of MSPs to farmers
during the said periods; and
(d) the action taken by Government to
safeguard the interests of the farmers?
Construction of railway line from
Sakri to Nirmali and from
Jhanjharpur to Laukaha
†*64. SHRI RAM NATH THAKUR:
Will the Minister of  RAILW AYS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the railway
line from Sakri to Jhanjharpur, Nirmali and
Saraigarh, from Jhanjharpur to Laukaha
Bazar is being converted into broad gauge;
(b) whether Railways have failed to
follow the set time-frame;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the
people of North Bihar are the most affected
ones; and
(d) the details of the measures taken to
start the above railway line by Government
in 2019?
Assistance to distressed coconut
growers of Kerala
*65. SHRI V. MURALEEDHARAN:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE AND
FARMERS WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the steps initiated by Government
to assist the coconut growers in distress in
Kerala due to sudden fall in procurement
price of coconut in recent months, if so,
the details thereof; and
(b) the steps taken by Government to
support and encourage coconut growers in
the country along with the details of the
amount allocated during the last five years
for the coconut growers, State-wise?
Cancellation of priority ration cards
*66. SHRI SANJAY SINGH: Will the
Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the priority
ration cards of families were cancelled for
not linking it to Aadhaar;
(b) the number of such cases and deaths
caused due to the cancellation of priority
ration cards in the past three years, State-
wise and year-wise; and
(c) the details and nature of
compensation provided by Government to
the family of the bereaved?
Requirement of quality seeds
*67. SHRI SYED NASIR HUSSAIN:
Will the Minister of  AGRICULTURE
AND FARMERS WELFARE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether demand of quality seeds
has been increasing over the last three years,
if so, the details of demand for quality seeds
in the country for current year and last
three years;
(b) in what manner the requirement of
seeds during natural calamities like flood,
drought, etc., would be met and details of
seeds reserved in the National Seed Reserve;
(c) whether Government provides
financial assistance to States and seed-
producing agencies for production and
distribution of seeds, if so, details thereof,
State-wise; and
(d) the crop development programmes/
schemes meant for production and
distribution of seeds, details thereof?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

times of the comprehensive cost, as per
recommendation of Swaminathan

by when the Committee's recommendation
would be implemented and if not, the
reasons therefor;

145
Relief measures for tackling drought
in Karnataka
603. SHRI SYED NASIR HUSSAIN:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE AND
FARMERS WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government is aware about
the severe drought situation in 24 districts
in the State of Karnataka, if so, whether
the Central Government has received
any reports of the State Government or
any agencies regarding the losses
incurred; and
(b) if so, the measures taken by the
Central Government to release financial
assistance for taking up drought relief
activities and paying compensation to the
affected farmers, along with the details
thereof?
Revival of cashew industry of
Kerala
604. SHRI SURESH GOPI: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE AND
FARMERS WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the measures Government has taken
or planning to take to revive the cashew
industry of Kerala;
(b) the details of communication from
Cashew Export Promotion Council of
India, Kollam about the Union Government
asking them to put forth a concrete proposal
for revival of the cashew industry; and
(c) the urgent steps Government has or
in planning to take in the interest of small
scale cashew entrepreneurs, whose
accounts have turned NPA or stressed?

146
Promoting cooperative
farming
605. SHRI PARTAP SINGH BAJWA:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE AND
FARMERS WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the distribution of landholdings in
hectares per farmer households, State-wise,
including Punjab;
(b) the average incomes earned from land
less than 0.5 hectares, between 0.5 and 1
hectares, between 1 and 2 hectares and
greater than 2 hectares, State-wise, including
Punjab;
(c) whether Government has any action
plan to promote cooperative farming to
make farming financially viable;
(d) if so, the details thereof, including
how the plan aims to tackle the
shortcomings in previous cooperative
farming plans, such as corruption, poor
governance and capital shortages; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Additional work for farmers
606. SHRI PARTAP SINGH BAJWA:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE AND
FARMERS WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has taken
cognizance of the findings of NABARD’s
All India Rural Financial Inclusion Survey
2016/17 regarding necessity for close to 88
per cent of farming households surveyed
to engage in other work in order to provide
household sustenance;
(b) if so, the details thereof, including
action taken thereon;
(c) whether Government has taken any
concrete steps to help farming households
to gain additional work;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the number of agro-processing
industries sanctioned and commissioned in
rural areas across the country, State-wise
along with the funding patterns and time-
line for implementation of each project?
Marketing and trading of farm
produce
607. SHRI VIJAY PAL SINGH
TOMAR:
SHRI HARNATH SINGH
Y ADAV:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
AND FARMERS WELFARE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether development and
upliftment of farmers is the first priority
of Government, if so, whether Government
is working on a concrete plan to link the
farmers with markets to help the farmers
in trading of foodgrain, if so, details thereof;
(b) whether marketing in farm produce
is carried out through the State
Governments across the country, if so, the
details thereof; and
(c) whether forward trading is an index
of predictive pricing and as a result both
buyer and seller can plan their futures
trading, if so, details thereof and the extent
to which it would help farmers?
Financial support to States for
implementing schemes
for farmers
608. SHRI HARNATH SINGH
Y ADAV:
SHRI VIJAY PAL SINGH
TOMAR:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
AND FARMERS WELFARE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether many State Governments

147
have come out with various schemes to
protect farmers from price volatility;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the Central Government
proposes to support farmers under the
existing schemes with remunerative prices
for agricultural and horticulture produce;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether the produce which are not
covered under MSP are likely to be covered
under Price Support Schemes (PSS) and
Market Intervention Scheme (MIS); and
(f) if so, the details thereof and financial
support provided to States in this regard?
Implementation of National Project
on soil health and fertility

Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE AND

(a) the salient features of the National
Soil Health C
